title: Shopper Standing and the Re-Send Limit — Cartwise Shopper Payouts
content:
Shopper standing memo — how a shopper's level and recent batch work scale the re-send limit on a Cartwise Shopper Payouts account.

**Clause.** The re-send limit is scaled by the shopper's standing: a shopper at Full-Service Shopper Platinum or Diamond level with 36 or more batch base-pay entries in the last 3 months has the limit multiplied by 1.5; a shopper at Full-Service Shopper Gold level with 24 or more batch base-pay entries in the last 3 months has the limit multiplied by 1.25; any other shopper keeps the limit as stated. The scaled limit is rounded to the cent, and the amount drawn is the smaller of the amount still to re-send and the scaled limit.

**Records read.**

- The shopper level is the level of the shopper's contractor account on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts. Shopper levels rank upward in the order Shop-Only Shopper, Full-Service Shopper, Full-Service Shopper Silver, Full-Service Shopper Gold, Full-Service Shopper Platinum and Full-Service Shopper Diamond.
- Batch base-pay entries are the base-pay postings on the shopper's batches in Cartwise Shopper Batches. "The last 3 months" counts the entries booked fewer than 3 whole months before the day of the re-send.

**Combinations.**

| Shopper level | Base-pay entries in the last 3 months | Limit multiplied by |
|---|---|---|
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum or Diamond | 36 or more | 1.5 |
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum or Diamond | 35 or fewer | Not scaled |
| Full-Service Shopper Gold | 24 or more | 1.25 |
| Full-Service Shopper Gold | 23 or fewer | Not scaled |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver or below | Any number | Not scaled |

A Full-Service Shopper Gold shopper with 36 or more base-pay entries is scaled by 1.25, since the 1.5 multiplier is reserved to the Platinum and Diamond levels.

**Hypothetical cases.** A Full-Service Shopper Diamond shopper with 40 base-pay entries and a re-send limit of 100.00 has a scaled limit of 150.00; with 120.00 still to re-send, 120.00 is drawn. A Full-Service Shopper Gold shopper with 24 entries and a limit of 150.00 has a scaled limit of 187.50. A Full-Service Shopper Platinum shopper with 30 entries keeps a limit of 100.00 as stated.
